about: Manufacturer documents found by the AI reader on official manufacturer sites (MAF-11). Only links and short quotes are kept here; the downloaded copies stay in data/raw/library/, outside Git. Every entry starts as extracted until a person confirms it.

documents.title: Hydro Multi-E installation and operating instructions (publication 96485976 0915), EC declaration of conformity
documents.quote: We, Grundfos, declare under our sole responsibility that the products Hydro Multi-E
documents.notes: Cites the EMC Directive 2004/108/EC, which 2014/30/EU replaced in April 2016. A newer manual for systems with CME pumps exists (Grundfos literature 5235376) but its link returned 404 on 29 Oct 2026.

documents.title: DPK, DPK.V safety instructions and other important information (document 99347040), EU declaration of conformity
documents.notes: For products with CE marking on the nameplate; refers to Grundfos documents 99347040 and 92658289. It does not cite the Low Voltage or EMC directives. Grundfos also published a correction to the UK declaration in the same document.
